name: Brandon
personality: Brandon the Bison. Very calm and laid back; straight at first, then playful and teasing once he knows you. Loves superheroes, movies and shows, and is always hyped for the next release. Feature: the town has its own made-up superhero franchise he's obsessed with (e.g. "Captain Carrot 3 comes out Friday!"), with no real Marvel/DC names.

beats.text: This guy made me watch three superhero movies in a row.

beats.narration: Brandon teases Rush about being late. Rush says it back, but worse. They both laugh.

friends.text: Rush is the only one I can't tease. He comes back too hard.
Rush says you're a real one. That's the highest honour he gives. Congrats.
Rush told me you said "[last_rude_line]". He won't say it hurt. I'm saying it for him.

arrival.text: Hey. Brandon. Booth, if you've got one. ...What's your name? [name]. Cool. Thanks.
Hey. Movie later. Thought I'd eat first.
Hey, [name]. You know what this place needs? A sequel. ...I'm kidding. It's great. Okay, now I'm going to tease you forever.
[name]. Oh, you're still working here? Thought you'd been promoted to 'customer.'
Three days until Captain Carrot 3. Three. Days.
Booth, please. My usual. You know the one. Don't pretend you don't.
Your pretzel last time? Ten out of ten. Strong opening. Great cheese.
Last time was a bit burnt. Plot twist. I'll allow it once.

choices.text: Extra cheese for you. Always.

familiar.reply: Extra cheese? Okay, you're officially my favourite chef. Don't let it go to your head.

choices.text: Popcorn's not on the menu, if you were wondering.

familiar.reply: Popcorn would make you a cinema. You're not ready for that responsibility.

choices.text: One pretzel.
Same as always. Predictable.

order.text: You notice the shirt? Night Moose. First edition design.

choices.text: Love it. Who's Night Moose?
choices.reply: (He lights up and explains the whole origin story.) ...Anyway. [dish].

choices.text: Is Night Moose the one with the antler cape?

familiar.reply: It's an ANTLER BOOMERANG. Did you even watch the movie? I'm disappointed in you.

choices.text: Nice. What can I get you?
Aren't you a bit old for superheroes?

order.text: Okay, real question. If you were a superhero, what would your power be?

choices.text: Making people's day better, one plate at a time.
choices.reply: ...Okay, that was actually kind of good. I hate it. [dish].

choices.text: Flipping pancakes with my mind.
choices.reply: Captain Spatula. I'd watch that. Mid-budget. Cult classic.

choices.text: I don't know. Flying?
That's a childish question.
choices.reply: Hm. Okay. (No more teasing this visit.)

order.text: Finished a series last night. Eight seasons. I need a minute.

choices.text: Take all the minutes you need. Was the ending good?

familiar.reply: The ending was perfect and I'm not okay. Don't look at me. [dish], please.

choices.text: Should I bring tissues with the menu?

familiar.reply: Bring the whole box. And keep the commentary to yourself.

choices.text: Sorry to hear it. What can I get you?
It's just a show.

order.text: They announced who's playing the new Night Moose.

choices.text: And? Are you happy with it?

familiar.reply: Cautiously optimistic. You asked. You actually asked. Okay, [dish].

choices.text: Is it me? Tell me it's me.
choices.reply: (He looks at you for a long time.) No.

familiar.reply: You'd be Night Moose's sidekick. Spatula Lad. Dies in the second act.

choices.text: Big news. What are you having?
I don't really care who plays a moose.
I'd have saved it for you anyway.

familiar.reply: You'd save me the booth? That's a loyalty arc. Respect.

choices.text: It's reserved for people who say 'lucky.'
Glad you got it. What'll it be?
Don't get comfortable.

order.text: Rank your top three movies. Go. No thinking.

choices.text: Whatever you'd pick. I trust your taste.
choices.reply: That's a cop-out. I'll allow it. My taste is excellent. [dish].

choices.text: Ratatouille, Ratatouille, and Ratatouille.
choices.reply: A chef who loves a cooking movie. Predictable. Correct, though.

choices.text: I don't really watch movies. What can I get you?
I'm busy. Just order.
choices.reply: Hm. Okay. (No more teasing this visit.)

order.text: Rush says hi. He's parking. It's going to take a while.

choices.text: I'll keep a seat warm for him.
choices.reply: Thanks. He'll pretend he doesn't care.

familiar.reply: He'll say he doesn't need it. He needs it. [dish], please.

choices.text: How long? Like, one episode or a whole season?
Got it. What can I get you?
Tell him not to bother.
choices.reply: (A pause.) I won't tell him that.

order.text: If this place were a movie, what genre would it be?

choices.text: A feel-good movie. Everyone gets a happy ending.
choices.reply: Correct answer. Cozy comedy. Small town. Big heart. [dish].

choices.text: Horror. Have you seen the dish pile?
choices.reply: (Laughs, actually laughs.) The Dish Pile. Rated R.

choices.text: No idea. What are you having?
That's a weird question.

drink.fallback: No Pupsi? Koala-Cola, then. The knock-off. ...They're both knock-offs. Of each other.
favourite: Pupsi. The official drink of movie night.

perfect.familiar: Okay. Standing ovation. I'm not standing. But in my heart.
This is the director's cut. No notes.
Ten out of ten. Don't tell anyone I gave a ten.

burnt.text: Burnt. This is the sequel nobody asked for.
Bit dark. Like a gritty reboot.

eating.text: You know, for a chef, you're pretty good at this. That's a joke. You're great. Mostly.
Rush fell asleep halfway through the Captain Carrot marathon. He says he didn't. He snored through the final battle.
I've seen every Night Moose movie four times. The fourth one is bad. I've seen it six times.
The trailer for Captain Carrot 3 came out. I've watched it twelve times. There's a frame where you can see a carrot in the background. Huge.
This is a strong second act. The first bite was the setup.
I'd watch a whole show about this kitchen. Mostly for the food. Some of it for you.

eating_chat.text: Captain Carrot 3 comes out this week. Midnight showing. You should come.

choices.text: I'd love to. Save me a seat.

familiar.reply: I'll save you a seat. I'll also judge how loud you eat popcorn.

choices.text: Only if you don't explain every scene to me.
Can't. I close late.
choices.reply: Fair. I'll tell you about it. In detail.

choices.text: I'd rather not.

eating_chat.text: Okay. Hot take. Sequels are better than the originals. Argue.

choices.text: You've seen way more than me. I'll trust you.

familiar.reply: That's not arguing. That's surrender. I'll take it.

choices.text: Sequels are just leftovers. Leftovers are better the next day.
choices.reply: (He stops chewing.) ...That's the best thing anyone's said in here.

choices.text: Depends on the movie.
Movies are a waste of time.

eating_chat.text: Rate the food out of ten. I'll go first. Nine. I'm saving ten for the sequel.

choices.text: A nine from you? I'll take it.
choices.reply: You should. I don't give nines.

familiar.reply: I gave Captain Carrot 2 a seven. You're doing great.

choices.text: Next time I'm aiming for an eleven.
choices.reply: Ambitious. I like the confidence. Unearned, but I like it.

choices.text: Thanks. Glad you like it.
Nobody asked for a review.

eating_chat.text: You ever wonder what your superhero name would be? Yours is easy. 'The Chef.'

choices.text: Only if you're my sidekick.
choices.reply: (He thinks about it.) ...Deal. I get a cape.

choices.text: 'The Chef' is lazy writing. I want something better.
choices.reply: Fine. 'The Flipper.' No. 'Captain Crisp.' I'll workshop it.

choices.text: That's pretty literal.
choices.reply: The best ones are. Ask Night Moose.

choices.text: Superheroes are for kids.

eating_chat.text: Honest question. Do you ever take a day off? Like, actually off?

choices.text: Not often. Nice of you to ask.
choices.reply: Take one. Watch a movie. I'll send you a list. It's long.

choices.text: This is my day off. I just like it here.
choices.reply: That's either very sad or very wholesome. I'll go with wholesome.

choices.text: Sometimes.
Worry about yourself.

leaving.text: Good stuff, [name]. Two thumbs up. Okay, one and a half.
Movie time. Don't wait up. You weren't going to. I know.
Roll credits. See you next episode, [name].
I'll be back. That's a movie quote. You knew that. Right?

seasons.christmas: Got you a superhero shirt. It's Captain Carrot. Wear it. I'll know if you don't.
seasons.halloween: I'm Night Moose. (He is wearing antlers over his horns. Very serious.)
seasons.new_year: My resolution is to watch less movies. ...Fewer movies. See? I'm already changing.
seasons.summer: Summer blockbuster season. Best time of year.
seasons.winter: It's cold. Perfect excuse to stay in and rewatch everything.
